faqs.q: How do I cook Sweet Potato Powder for a 6-month+ baby?
faqs.a: Whisk 1 teaspoon of Sweet Potato Powder into 1/2 cup of cold water or milk (so there are no lumps), then simmer on low heat for 2–3 minutes while stirring until smooth and creamy (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician).

faqs.q: Why do babies love Sweet Potato Porridge?
faqs.a: Sweet potato has a mild, naturally sweet flavor and creamy texture without any fibrous strings, making it one of the easiest first solid foods for infants.
